title: EWMA Latency Anomaly Detector
signature: class EwmaDetector: __init__(self, alpha, k, warmup, min_std), update(self, value) -> dict, attributes mean, var
hints: Score each point against the baseline as it was BEFORE the point. Updating first lets the spike pull the mean toward itself and hide.
z = (x - mean) / max(sqrt(var), min_std). The floor keeps a perfectly flat series from flagging a 1 ms wobble.
Anomalous points are reported but never folded into mean or var, or one incident teaches the detector that incidents are normal.
Incremental EWMA: diff = x - mean; mean += alpha * diff; var = (1 - alpha) * (var + alpha * diff**2).
